about: Human whole-blood clot, calibrated by the plugin's pure-shear replication against the digitised tests of Lohr, Bechtel, Dortdivanlioglu and Rausch (2025, Int. J. Fract., doi:10.1007/s10704-024-00820-4): a Yeoh law fitted to the unnotched mean, the AT2 toughness from notch group 4's peak force. Every value is labelled by its source; a value marked placeholder is not a measurement.

labels.yeoh_c1: fitted: the plugin's pure-shear study (incompressible plane stress, l 0.25 mm, h 0.0625 mm) to Lohr et al. 2025 Fig. 1A's unnotched mean (digitised), NRMSE 1.4 % of its maximum; C1 = mu / 2
labels.yeoh_c2: fitted: the same fit, Yeoh's second coefficient
labels.poisson_ratio: placeholder: the fit was incompressible; a compressible 3-D or axisymmetric build needs a bulk modulus, and 0.45 (kappa about 9.7 mu) is chosen for the solver's conditioning, not measured
labels.young_modulus: derived: 2 mu (1 + nu) with mu = 2 C1 and the placeholder nu
labels.toughness: calibrated: the AT2 Gc at which the model's group-4 peak force meets the data's (69.56 against 69.30 mN), inside Lohr et al.'s Griffith-A mean of 0.9 +- 0.38 J/m^2; in incompressible plane stress at l 0.25 mm
labels.length_scale: chosen: the replication's AT2 length scale (its Gc is tied to it)
labels.stretch_limit: placeholder (read only by the element-deletion control)
labels.residual_stiffness: numerical: the fully damaged material's share of stiffness

model: Yeoh (C1, C2) with a compressible bulk term and an AT2 phase field; the clot's viscoelasticity, fluid and heterogeneity are not in it
